channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Eric Gordon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Eric Gordon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Nwaba on Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker
item.description:
David Nwaba:

“Right now, I haven’t seen too many of my teammates. I’ve run into PJ Tucker, Eric Gordon. Not too many guys I’ve run into right now but I’m sure they’re doing their own things, just trying to get their body right. doing the little things to keep their body in shape and to stay in shape and that’s what I’m trying to do as well. I’m just focused on just getting my body right. And just being ready for this season.”

David Nwaba on Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker, Oct 13, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Eric Gordon
item.description:
Salman Ali:Mike D'Antoni on Eric Gordon:

“He's one day closer to coming back... He's in great spirits and feels good. He continues to get treatment. The training staff is all over it.”

Mike D'Antoni on Eric Gordon, Jul 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker
item.description:
Tilman Fertitta:

“I think we’re all excited to see sports today. I think we’re really excited to see the NBA because in the NBA we really know our players. Fans know their personalities. We’re so lucky to have the team we have. When you look at James (Harden) and Russ (Westbrook) and P.J. (Tucker) and Eric (Gordon), it’s exciting. I think we have as good a chance as anybody. I think the NBA and team owners have taken our time to make sure we did this right and it’s safe for everybody. I know that everybody is excited to play. I didn’t want to play if the players didn’t want to play and everybody’s happy to play.”

Tilman Fertitta on James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker, Jun 6, 2020. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Eric Gordon
item.description:
D'Antoni on Eric Gordon being out 6 weeks:

“It's been bothering him, actually, from the middle of last year. I think he's probably relieved that he can clean it up, get it going, so he can come as back strong as ever.”

Mike D'Antoni on Eric Gordon, Nov 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Chris Paul, Eric Gordon
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Austin Rivers:

“You have guys like Chris Paul and Eric Gordon, and you have other guys waiting, trying to help even more, but our system is designed around it. It was a circle of everybody trying to figure out how do we change this, who do we talk to? It was frustrating.”

Austin Rivers on Chris Paul, Eric Gordon, Jun 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Jae Crowder on James Harden, Eric Gordon
item.description:
On Saturday, Crowder confirmed what many people who saw the video clip guessed — Beverley was trying to help him and the Jazz defeat Harden.

“He was just giving insight of how he thinks we as a team and me personally and guys who guard Harden and Eric Gordon and all those guys, how to approach the game,”

Jae Crowder on James Harden, Eric Gordon, Apr 14, 2019. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Trevor Ariza, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker
item.description:
Meanwhile, Warriors coach Steve Kerr and his staff spent the past three days trying to find solutions for all these unique challenges.

“Well, they do a ton of switching, like we do, and they've got a lot of guys who they may not be the Greek Freak (Antetokounmpo) or (Durant), but they're good-sized guys with Trevor Ariza, PJ Tucker, Eric Gordon,”

Steve Kerr on Trevor Ariza, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker, May 20, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Frank Vogel on James Harden, Eric Gordon
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:Frank Vogel on Eric Gordon:

“He concerns me not as much as James Harden, but almost as much as Harden.”

Frank Vogel on James Harden, Eric Gordon, Jan 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.
